reproduced_exactly: population size 40, max generations 100, crossover 0.80, mutation 0.05
uniform crossover on the feature mask, parameter-wise crossover on H
bit-flip mutation on F and bounded jitter mutation on H
minimum of 10 selected features enforced after mutation
stopping on max generations or 10 generations without fitness gain
bagging ensemble of decision trees with majority-vote aggregation
modified: scikit-learn BaggingClassifier(DecisionTreeClassifier) is used; the original was run in WEKA, whose default tree induction (REPTree/J48) differs in pruning and split criteria

GA fitness is evaluated on a stratified subsample of the training split and with a reduced number of CV folds, because a 40x100x10 grid of bagged-ensemble fits over the full ~350k-row training split is computationally infeasible here; the exact budget used is recorded in the run's result file

the GA search is executed once per (representation, task) using the search seed, and the resulting feature subset and hyperparameters are then refitted per evaluation seed; the original paper does not state a multi-seed protocol
min-max scaling to [0,1] as described in the original is applied inside this baseline rather than the project's default quantile scaler, so that the baseline matches its own published preprocessing
not_reproducible: the exact training/test partition, which the original does not publish
the exact 33,079-instance subset of MQTT-IoT-IDS2020 used in the original (the released uni-flow feature set contains substantially more records); the sampling procedure is not described
the WEKA random seed and internal implementation details
the original SMOTE configuration beyond 'applied within each training fold'
fidelity.consequence: Numbers produced by this module are a good-faith reimplementation under this project's protocol. They are reported as 'GA-EBT (reproduced)' and are never substituted for, or presented as, the 99.997% figure reported in the original paper. The original figure is quoted only as a literature value with its own protocol attached.

search_config.budget_note: Reduced from the published 10-fold CV over the full training split; see FIDELITY['modified'].
